purpose: Post-hoc qualitative examples from the frozen final holdout; no tuning or model changes
selection_policy: Manual purposive selection of three ordinary neutral queries after the final audit: clear gain over both lexical methods, failure below both, and an improvement over LTR below BM25F. These examples are not a random or representative sample.
metric_note: nDCG@10 uses the complete top 10; only top 3 are displayed for readability. Labels are copied from official competition qrels, not reassessed here.
limitations: These selected cases neither estimate error frequency nor identify causal mechanisms. Overall quality and uncertainty must be assessed on all holdout queries.
